defects: hantitone uses global `Antitone f` instead of gold's `AntitoneOn f (Ici 0)`, requiring the function to be antitone on all of ℝ rather than just on [0,∞), which is a stronger/less general hypothesis
hnoneg uses global `∀ x, 0 ≤ f x` instead of gold's nonnegativity restricted to `Ioi 0`, again a stronger/less general hypothesis than needed
hintegrable uses `IntegrableOn f (Ici 0)` instead of gold's `IntegrableOn f (Ioi 0)` — mathematically near-equivalent (differs by a measure-zero point) but not syntactically the same domain
